summary: Python CLI and library aligns supplied lyric text to audio using Whisper word timestamps and sequence alignment, then emits timestamped LRC lines. Supports local or remote transcription; local Whisper and optional Demucs add substantial dependencies.
use_when: Align provided lyrics to audio and export timestamped LRC lines
Create line timings from Whisper word timestamps without manually syncing each line
avoid_when: Use a transcription tool when you need a verbatim transcript without supplied lyrics
Use caption editors when you need interactive correction and subtitle authoring
